posts.description: DR Checker gives you a free Ahrefs Domain Rating lookup without signup. Enter a domain to see its DR score and a plain-English interpretation. For larger lists, check up to 100 domains at once and export the results as CSV. The site also includes free tools for domain authority, domain age, and Google search snippet previews.

posts.name: Directlifly
posts.tagline: Find and explore direct flight routes from your city.
posts.description: Layovers waste hours, and most flight sites assume you already know where you're going. Directlifly works the other way around: start from your airport and discover every direct route. Filter by visa eligibility, flight time and trip type, then check what matters before you go: best time to visit, visa needs, plug adapters, eSIM options and local taxi apps. Free, no signup.

posts.name: RouteCord
posts.tagline: Transfer Discord voice between channels. Record each person.
posts.description: RouteCord lets you route audio between Discord voice channels and record each participant on a separate track. It runs in your browser using your own Discord bots. Built for recording sessions, streams, and games like Werewolf.

posts.name: Morse
posts.tagline: Meetings that write the notes and book the follow-up
posts.description: Morse is a video meeting app that does the admin around the meeting. Type a sentence and it schedules: it finds the people, checks calendars and offers a time. During the call it answers questions from your own notes and files. Afterwards the summary, decisions and to-dos are already written, each linked to its moment in the recording. It hides figures when you share notes with guests, and books the follow-up before anyone hangs up.

posts.name: Humandex
posts.tagline: AI on your side: see and shape what recruiters find
posts.description: Hiring: years of experience, reduced to keywords. Systems scan resumes. AI searches the web. Machines decide who gets seen by humans. Humandex reveals what AI knows about professionals—and what it misses. It turns public information into profiles backed by sources and human confirmations, with AI visibility checks, peer comparisons, and recommendations for improvement. Apparently, doing good work isn't enough anymore. The machines need to notice.

posts.name: DockLog
posts.tagline: Docker & Kubernetes logs without the logging stack
posts.description: Monitor container and pod logs, track host performance, manage Docker and Kubernetes workloads with RBAC, and route alert rules to Slack, Teams, Discord, or custom webhooks. One self-hosted image.

posts.name: Categent AI
posts.tagline: AI agents that talk, support, sell, and take action
posts.description: Categent helps businesses deploy AI agents across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, and website chat. These agents can answer customer questions, capture leads, qualify prospects, book appointments, support shoppers, and automate conversations 24/7. Build once, connect your channels, and let Categent handle customer interactions at scale.

posts.name: Uzo Labs
posts.tagline: The Infrastructure Layer for BOT Chain
posts.description: SDKs, templates and infrastructure that take developers from zero to shipped on BOT Chain. Built in Lagos.

posts.name: twirl
posts.tagline: High quality PBR materials
posts.description: twirl is an AI PBR material generator for high quality tileable maps: albedo, normal, roughness, metallic, and height. Unlimited free material downloads, no sign up. Generate your own when you need something specific. Free plan includes 5 generations a day. Standard is $16/mo. Pro is $25/mo.

posts.name: Free MP3 to MP4 Video Maker Visualizers
posts.tagline: Free MP3 to MP4 Video Maker for Android & Windows
posts.description: Turn MP3 audio into eye-catching MP4 videos with animated music visualizers, custom covers, titles, descriptions, Google Fonts, and flexible layouts. Create videos in 1:1, 9:16, or 16:9, with 720p or 1080p export. Perfect for music, podcasts, voice recordings, YouTube, Shorts, Reels, and social media. Available on Android and Windows.

posts.name: Habit8
posts.tagline: Track 8 habits. See what’s actually working.
posts.description: Most apps encourage you to track more and more habits.But we wanted a focused system around the 8 habits that matter most to you. Habit8 lets you track your consistency, uncover patterns, and understand how your habits actually perform over time. The Eight Map gives you a bigger picture, while performance insights help you understand where you're improving and where you might be losing consistency. The goal isn't to build the perfect routine. It's to build a system you can actually stick with.

posts.name: Tally
posts.tagline: Private expense tracking without linking your bank
posts.description: Tally is a simple, privacy-focused expense tracker for people who want to understand where their money goes without connecting their bank account. Log expenses manually, scan receipts with AI, or import bank statements when needed. Review your spending, organize expenses and stay in control of your data — without turning personal finance into another complicated budgeting system.

posts.name: Gmail Cleanup
posts.tagline: Mass delete Gmail emails by sender
posts.description: Gmail Cleanup is a Chrome extension that makes email cleaning simple. Delete all messages from any sender in 1 click. No sign-in is needed, and your inbox data stays on your device.

posts.name: LitoAI
posts.tagline: Chat, voice, memory — and a coding agent for Windows
posts.description: LitoAI is a personal AI assistant ecosystem: one account, one memory, three surfaces — web, Android, and LitoCode, a coding agent for Windows. Chat with streaming answers, real-time voice over WebRTC, user-controlled semantic memory, image & video generation, web research, autonomous agents, scheduled routines and a privacy mode that never persists. LitoCode (private beta) maps your project, plans multi-file edits and verifies results locally, with visible permissions.

posts.name: ParkLive —  Live Parking Signals
posts.tagline: Live parking signals from drivers near you
posts.description: ParkLive is a community-powered parking network. Drivers signal when they leave a spot, helping nearby drivers discover fresh parking leads instead of circling the block and guessing.

posts.name: Alcove
posts.tagline: A calmer new tab page
posts.description: A calmer new tab page: your own wallpaper, the links you actually use, and small tools that open when you need them.

posts.name: GOATvs
posts.tagline: Who's the GOAT? Pick one of two, see how the world splits
posts.description: GOATvs ranks the greatest of all time with one question: which of these two? Vote in 10 categories (people, football, songs, movies, series, games, books, inventions, places, beauty) and see the world's split on every pair. Every Top 100 is built from everyone's head-to-head picks. Play Today's Challenge (guess what the world picked, one wrong answer ends it), vote in the daily Face-off, or make a room and play with friends on your own phones. Free, no app, no ads.

posts.name: RideLoop
posts.tagline: System for bike rentals, guided tours and cycling holidays
posts.description: RideLoop is now live, booking and operations software built for bike rental, guided tour, and cycling holiday businesses. Operators get a branded storefront, individual bike-level fleet tracking, guided tour logistics, and payments settling directly into their own Stripe account. It also includes automatic weather-triggered rescheduling and Miles, a built-in AI assistant. Built by people who actually run a bike shop, not a generic SaaS team guessing at the industry.

posts.name: Lánzalo
posts.tagline: Launch and discover products from Latin America
posts.description: Lánzalo is a free, early-beta community for launching and discovering products built in Latin America. Publish a product page with images and a link to your site. Browse regional apps, SaaS and tools, vote and comment. Available in Spanish and English.

posts.name: PixSip
posts.tagline: Private image compression, right in your browser
posts.description: Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and HEIC images in your browser, and convert them to AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP, JPG or PNG. No uploads, no signup, no watermark.

posts.name: Bisa
posts.tagline: A Decentralized Agentic IDE
posts.description: One desktop app for the coding agents you already use — Claude Code, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenCode and more: a Project IDE where they work beside you, agents and teams to staff the work, workflows you read before they run, and goals you come back to. No server and no account: your workspace lives on your machine, your identity is a Nostr key, and the people you invite meet you over relays that carry only ciphertext.

posts.name: hibrane
posts.tagline: Never miss a stealth policy or regulatory change again
posts.description: Hibrane monitors live regulatory websites, legal frameworks, and vendor policies 24/7. Unlike dumb webpage scrapers that alert you on every cookie banner or CSS shift, Hibrane filters out HTML noise, calculates structural diffs, and uses AI to deliver clear executive summaries, risk impact ratings, and instant alerts the moment a critical clause changes.
